item.title: REF 0.2.0
item.description:
• Saved reference sets: name a set and it opens again next time, even when its songs' files have moved.
  • The Tracks tab: drop a folder of your song's tracks and REF names the pairs that cancel each other (a kick and a bass, two snare mics, a bus running late), with the fix, and plays each pair as it is and fixed.
  • The zoomed waveform: both songs zoomed in on where they are, with the beat grid and bar numbers. Left and Right jump by bars, + and - zoom.
